title: [Core] Migrate `Variant` method binding to `GDType` and unify with `Object` approach

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- Follow-up to #117451
- Work towards https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/13216
- Inadvertently closes #118184, superseding #118290
- Requires #124362 (squashed into one commit in this PR for simplicity)

As the next step in the unification journey, `Variant` method bindings are migrated to `GDType`. In order to achieve this, they are switched from using the internal `VariantBuiltInMethodInfo` `struct` to using `MethodBind` like everyone else. 

This greatly simplifies the `variant_call.cpp` implementation, thereby reducing code by 477 lines or 16%. This does come at a cost in `method_bind_common.h` where 224 LOC are added, reducing the benefits from #124362.

As a side bonus due to using `MethodBind`, any method inspecting these bindings gains access to richer information. This is taken advantage of (purely by accident) by the doctool, thereby closing #118184. Documentation descriptions were updated to reflect the fact that the returns/parameters now link correctly, and thus not needing manual linking to the associated Enum in the method description. 

## Additional information

It is technically possible to achieve this migration without #124362, as was done in v2: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/compare/master...StarryWorm:godot:unified-methods-v2. That approach, however, requires more code and is less elegant. 

> Draft until the required PR is merged. This PR is technically ready for review and fully functional as is.

> AI disclosure: A vast majority (95%+) of the code was written by me. AI use was limited to bug fixing at the intersection of templates+macros, things like a missing `&` or `*`.
